name: OpenCost Kubernetes Cost Monitoring (Self-Hosted)
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source Kubernetes/cloud cost allocation engine, APIs, metrics and UI; no software subscription fee or vendor-imposed usage quota.
watch_out: Requires your own Kubernetes cluster, Helm and Prometheus; compute, storage, monitoring retention, cloud billing APIs and related infrastructure may cost money. This is not a free hosted Kubernetes or cloud account.
